desc: Get yourself out a jam with the new RCBS Pow'r Pull Kit. This kinetic style bullet puller's rugged one-piece body and user-friendly ergonomic handle resolves mistakes quickly and easily. The three case holding chucks will accommodate case from 5.7x28mm and.22 Hornet up through the WSM and RUM family of cartridges. All inclusive kit. Three chucks included. Accepts cases from 5.7x28mm to WSM.
